steps.slow: Installing .NET Framework 4.8 usually takes 20 to 40 minutes and looks idle for long stretches while Microsoft's compiler services run. That's normal — let it finish.

steps.text: .NET Framework 4.8 installed. The install takes 20 to 40 minutes and looks idle for long stretches while Microsoft's compiler services run, that's normal. 32-bit .NET apps (like Assetto Corsa's launcher) work; 64-bit .NET apps may still crash, a known Wine limitation.

knownIssues.cause: known Wine issue with the 64-bit CLR under new WoW64 (WineHQ bug 57792)
knownIssues.fix: use the 32-bit version of the program where offered (Content Manager has a setting for it)

lastVerified.result: winetricks dotnet48 completes (exit 0, no aborts) with WINE_BIN/WINESERVER_BIN/WINE_BINDIR set and bash invocation; NDP v4 Full Release=528049 (.NET 4.8) confirmed in registry
